description: Archived Level II volumes the real fixtures are made from. They are kept outside Git; tools/make_fixtures.py checks each file against its bytes and sha256 here.

sources.description: Wichita: storms northwest and south of the radar. The primary sample; the revised and invalid fixtures are derived from it.

Oklahoma City (Twin Lakes): the Moore, Oklahoma EF5 tornado of May 20, 2013 crossing central Moore, about 20 km west of the radar. A tornado debris signature (low CC in strong reflectivity) on the lowest tilt.
